instruction: Withdraw: Coins, Chronicle, Barcrawl Card, all Wines
Leave the Tzhaar cave. Quickly climb the Rope
Complete the Barcrawl at Musa Point
Head West to Brimhaven Agility Arena. Pay to enter the Agility Arena
Cross the rope swing and Pillars South

Jump over the Floor Spikes indefinitely. Tag close by Pillars that are within 3 1-39 Obstacles. NOTE: If no arrow is showing up hop worlds. OPTIONAL: Install the Detached Camera plugin on Runelite. It lets you use mouse keys to jump over Floor Spikes.

Bank at Ardy South bank for more wines when needed. Keep health low to take less damage. At level 55 you can just chase tickets rather than spike jump. Stay until level 60 (If you want a break you can go to the Colossal Wyrm Agility Course at 50 but it is slower)
OPTIONAL: Get Graceful if you want but it's not that good. You should get a couple pieces later on the Seers course
Buy 2x Toadflax from the agility arena shop [Tai Bwo Wannai Trio]
Trade Candle maker & buy candle [Kandarin Easy Diary]
Buy a pack of empty buckets from Arhein
Bank all At Catherby bank. OPTIONAL: Buy your 100 Soda Ash/Sand if haven't yet
